caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jar or crock with a rounded, bulbous body and two horizontally-oriented handles on opposite sides near the top. The surface of the jar is smooth with a predominantly brownish-beige color, punctuated with subtle variations in shading and spotty marks. There is a decorative band near the top featuring a blue pattern that resembles garlands or draped fabric with small geometric shapes hanging down. The upper lip of the jar is slightly flared with horizontal banding for additional detail. In the center of the jar's body, in blue capital letters, the text "CORLEARS" is inscribed. The background is an even off-white or light beige tone, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Stoneware Crock
